description: Suggests a change to one element of a Little Milwaukee page (a place, neighborhood, category or collection). Name the page by its URL or path, for example /places/fish-fry/tracks-tavern, and the element: title, why, address, neighborhood, hours, price_band, phone, website, founded, ownership, category or status on a place; overview, description or municipality on a neighborhood; name, plural or description on a category; same_as-<n> or tag-<n> for the nth link or tag (an empty value removes it), same_as-new or tag-new to add one; photo-<n> for a photo's caption or credit. Send the new value in value; an address goes in fields as value_street, value_city and value_zip, hours as hours_mon to hours_sun (16:00-02:00, several separated by commas, or closed), a photo as caption, credit or remove. An automatic check reads every suggestion against the page's own sources and can accept a small change it confirms when the suggestion comes from a confirmed identity: a signed-in person, a verified claimant or a Neighborhood Mayor. Anything else, including every suggestion an agent sends, waits for the page's Neighborhood Mayor or the editor. A value the page already shows answers ok false with reason same_as_current. The answer holds a status_url for the decision. A source_url helps them read it; the judge does not count it as a source.

contact.description: An email or phone for the outcome; only the mayor and the editor see it.

element.description: The element id, for example phone or same_as-0.

fields.description: The parts of an address, hours or photo change.

note.description: Why the change is right, for the mayor and the editor.

page.description: The page URL or path, for example /places/fish-fry/tracks-tavern.

source_url.description: A web address where a person can check the new value, such as the business's own page. Strongly preferred.

value.description: The new value of a single-value element.

name: suggest_edit
